plan.problem: Author's real iPhone Chrome loses saving near month 154 due to origin-shared localStorage quota; existing diagnosis and backup tools are inadequate for long-term storage.
plan.currentContract: Formal v8 serialized JSON and localStorage main.v1 CAS are synchronous; game advances only if validated and write-back succeeded. Existing stop-on-quota retains last committed.
plan.whyExistingIsInsufficient: Classic localStorage shares the origin with old game experiments and reaches quota before even 13 years. H1-A4 research tests IDB but does not handle actual v8 file or attach to current game.
plan.design: A staging-only atomic IDB head+previous store with same-transaction CAS revision, verified exact v8 text before and after storage; explicit local-file preflight page with no automatic migration. The interface anticipates async main-game adaptation without claiming it has occurred.
plan.migration: Only explicitly selected external JSON is copied into an independent staging IndexedDB after full validation. Existing main.v1 and all other storage keys are untouched. Later game migration will require a separate guarded plan.
plan.compatibility: Existing formal v8 JSON reader/codec and game behavior remain untouched; IDB adapter remains a separate module. Cross-origin/browser-local data never uploaded.
plan.promotionRisk: Staging-only direct URL. Production remains on existing localStorage until independent owner-approved promotion.
